headline: Brazil Ibovespa Jumps 1.39% as Real Weakens After Strong US Payrolls
summary: Brazil's Ibovespa index rose 1.39% on Friday to finish the week flat, while the US dollar gained 1.18% against the Brazilian real following stronger-than-expected US labor market data.
why: The Ibovespa is Latin America's largest stock index, heavily weighted toward natural resources and commercial banking.

impacts.name: IBOVESPA
impacts.why: Bargain-hunting in domestic Brazilian equities drove a late-week index rebound.
